dedupe_keys.name: nationwide dataset of drinking water distribution zones in aotearoa new zealand university of otago

description: This dataset maps the public drinking water distribution zones of Aotearoa New Zealand consistently across the country, and is described in a Data in Brief article by University of Otago researchers. Spatial data came from all 67 district and city councils through information requests between 2021 and 2023, from the Ministry of Health and from the Institute of Environmental Science and Research; zones were corrected with building footprints from Land Information New Zealand and reticulation data from WSP and councils, coded with the regulator Taumata Arowai zone codes, and linked to Statistics New Zealand meshblocks to estimate population served. Coverage is New Zealand. The data are two GeoPackage layers and two CSV files, free through the OSF link given in the article. Licence: not stated for the resource; the describing article (doi:10; reuse terms therefore remain unverified.1016/j.dib.2023.109349) is CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0. Simulation uses: mapping which areas and populations each supply zone serves, for exposure and supply planning. Related records: Taumata Arowai water services registers (data-nz-taumata-arowai-water-services-registers) and the Water New Zealand performance review (data-water-nz-national-performance-review).
